name: EAC
expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Actual Cost] + [Forecast to Complete],
    REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate )
)

name: Project Completion %
expression:
DIVIDE (
    SUMX (
        VALUES ( DimProject[ProjectKey] ),
        CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[ApprovedBudget] ) )
            * CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[PercentComplete] ) )
    ),
    [Approved Budget] * 100
)

name: Earned Value (Mock)
expression:
SUMX (
    VALUES ( DimProject[ProjectKey] ),
    CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[ApprovedBudget] ) )
        * DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[PercentComplete] ) ), 100 )
)

name: Labor Cost Variance $
expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Phased Budget],
    FactFinancial[CostCategory] IN { "Labor", "Contractor" },
    FactFinancial[PeriodType] = "Actual"
)
    - CALCULATE (
        [Actual Labor Cost],
        FactFinancial[CostCategory] IN { "Labor", "Contractor" },
        FactFinancial[PeriodType] = "Actual"
    )

name: Labor Cost Variance %
expression:
VAR LaborPlan =
    CALCULATE (
        [Phased Budget],
        FactFinancial[CostCategory] IN { "Labor", "Contractor" },
        FactFinancial[PeriodType] = "Actual"
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( [Labor Cost Variance $], LaborPlan )

name: Weighted Utilization Target %
expression:
DIVIDE (
    SUMX (
        FactLabor,
        FactLabor[AvailableHours] * RELATED ( DimEmployee[UtilizationTarget] )
    ),
    [Available Hours]
)

name: Employee Utilization Band
expression:
VAR Utilization = [Labor Utilization %]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( Utilization ), BLANK (),
        Utilization < 0.60, "<60%",
        Utilization < 0.75, "60–74%",
        Utilization < 0.85, "75–84%",
        Utilization <= 1.00, "85–100%",
        ">100%"
    )

name: Actual FTE
expression:
AVERAGEX (
    VALUES ( DimDate[YearMonth] ),
    CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactWorkforcePlan[ActualFTE] ) )
)

name: Required FTE
expression:
AVERAGEX (
    VALUES ( DimDate[YearMonth] ),
    CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactWorkforcePlan[RequiredFTE] ) )
)

name: Open Demand FTE

)

name: Contractor FTE
expression:

name: Active Projects
Projects At Risk
Open Critical Risks
Critical Risks without Mitigation
expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( FactRiskIssue ),
    FactRiskIssue[IsCritical] = 1,
    FactRiskIssue[RiskStatus] IN { "Open", "Monitoring" },
    FactRiskIssue[MitigationStatus] = "Not Started"
)

name: Cost Health
expression:
VAR OverrunPct = DIVIDE ( [EAC] - [Approved Budget], [Approved Budget] )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( [Approved Budget] ), BLANK (),
        OverrunPct > 0.10, "Red",
        OverrunPct >= 0.03, "Amber",
        "Green"
    )

name: Schedule Health
expression:
VAR CriticalDelay = [Max Critical Milestone Delay Days]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( CriticalDelay ), "Green",
        CriticalDelay > 30, "Red",
        CriticalDelay >= 8, "Amber",
        "Green"
    )

name: Labor Health
expression:
VAR Gap = [Utilization Gap pp]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( Gap ), "Green",
        Gap < -0.12, "Red",
        Gap < -0.05, "Amber",
        "Green"
    )

name: Risk Health
expression:
SWITCH (
    TRUE (),
    [Critical Risks without Mitigation] > 0, "Red",
    [Overdue Actions] > 0, "Amber",
    "Green"
)

name: Overall Project Health
expression:
VAR CostStatus = [Cost Health]
VAR ScheduleStatus = [Schedule Health]
VAR LaborStatus = [Labor Health]
VAR RiskStatus = [Risk Health]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        "Red" IN { CostStatus, ScheduleStatus, LaborStatus, RiskStatus }, "Red",
        "Amber" IN { CostStatus, ScheduleStatus, LaborStatus, RiskStatus }, "Amber",
        "Green"
    )

name: Red Projects
Amber Projects
Green Projects
Projects with Budget-Consumption Red Flag
Projects with Any Red Flag
expression:
COUNTROWS (
    FILTER (
        VALUES ( DimProject[ProjectKey] ),
        [Overall Project Health] = "Red"
            || [Budget vs Completion Gap pp] >= 0.15
    )
)
